acceptanceCriteria: docs/decisions/README.md has a header row and one row per decision file.
script/check-decision-numbers.sh fails on a duplicate or missing index row, with a test.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the V1-0131 fix (PR #186). After deduplication the decision index still has no table header, lists 235 rows for 288 decision files (about 51 missing), and script/check-decision-numbers.sh does not refuse duplicate rows, which is how the 0353 duplicate reappeared.
title: docs: decisions/README.md has no header row, indexes 235 of 288 decisions, and nothing checks for duplicate rows
